title: Smart Data Models - GS1 Web Vocabulary - Offer
description: An offer to transfer some rights to an item or to provide a service,for example, an offer to sell tickets to an event, to rent the DVD of a movie, to stream a TV show over the internet, to repair a motorcycle, or to loan a book. (GS1 Web Vocabulary 1.18 class gs1:Offer. Property names verbatim.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Offer'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

acceptedPaymentMethod.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/acceptedPaymentMethod'. Code indicating a means of payment, for example, BANK_CHEQUE, CASH, etc. Values are GS1 code-list members as compact IRIs (gs1:<Code>); deprecated codes are left out.

availabilityEnds.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/availabilityEnds'. The date from which the product is no longer available from the information provider, including seasonal or temporary product and services .

availabilityStarts.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/availabilityStarts'. The date from which the product is available from the information provider, including seasonal or temporary product and services.

availableAtOrFrom.description: Relationship. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/availableAtOrFrom'. The location the offered product or service is available from. Points to Place entities.

itemOffered.description: Relationship. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/itemOffered'. The product included in the offer. Points to Product entities.

offerDescription.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/offerDescription'. A description of the offer including goods or services offered for sale or use.

offerDiscount.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/offerDiscount'. A discount associated with an offer.

offerRedemptionURL.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/offerRedemptionURL'. The URL where the offer seeker will need to go in order to redeem the offer for an online redemption.

paymentTerms.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/paymentTerms'. The type of payment term expressed as a code, for example Discount.

priceSpecification.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/priceSpecification'. The price related to an offer. If the offer is a multi-buy offer for a quantity of product greater than one unit, this should be indicated using the property gs1:eligibleQuantity

seeker.description: Relationship. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/seeker'. The organization seeking an offer. Points to Organization entities.

seller.description: Relationship. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/seller'. The organization seeking to sell a product or service. Points to Organization entities.

warranty.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/warranty'. The warranty associated with the product, as provided by the manufacturer.

additionalProductClassificationCode.description: Code specifying the applied additional product classification scheme.

additionalProductClassificationCodeDescr.description: A description related to the additional product classification code value.

additionalProductClassificationValue.description: Code specifying an additional product classification other than the GS1 Global Product Classification. The applied classification scheme is specified as additional information together with the classification value.

discountRepeatsPerMultipleMinimum.description: If specified and set to true, the discount is available for each time the minimum qualifying criteria are met. This can be used to express '$10 off each $50 spend', which is distinct from a 20% discount because it is quantized in units of spending.

discountType.description: A code that specifies the type of payment discount applicable to an offer, for example BOGO.

eligibleTradeChannel.description: A code determining the location where a user can redeem the offer, for example ONLINE_ONLY.

exactDiscountAmount.description: Links to a gs1:PriceSpecification that indicates in terms of an amount and specified currency, the exact discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express '$10 off'.

exactDiscountPercentage.description: A floating-point value indicating an exact percentage discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express '15% discount'.

exclusionDescription.description: A text description of any products, brands, or categories that cannot be used with the offer

isOnlyAvailableThroughRetailer.description: If specified and set to true, the discount is only available through the retailer making the offer.

isOnlyWithMailingListSignup.description: If specified and set to true, the discount is only available for customers who have signed up to the retailer's mailing list.

isOnlyWithPaymentCard.description: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing using one of the specified payment card types.

isOnlyWithRetailerLoyaltyCard.description: If specified and set to true, the discount is only available for holders of the retailer's own loyalty card.

isOnlyWithRetailerPaymentCard.description: If specified and set to true, the discount is only available for holders of the retailer's own store payment card.

isPromoterExclusiveOffer.description: Determines whether the offer is only provided by the promoter

maximumDiscountAmount.description: Links to a gs1:PriceSpecification that indicates in terms of an amount and specified currency, the maximum discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'up to $10 off'.

maximumDiscountPercentage.description: A floating-point value indicating a maximum percentage discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'up to 15% discount'.

maximumQualifyingItems.description: Specifies the maximum number of items that qualify for a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'maximum N items per customer'.

maximumQualifyingSpend.description: Links to a gs1:PriceSpecification that indicates in terms of an amount and specified currency, the maximum spend that qualifies for a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'for purchases of up to $100'.

minimumDiscountAmount.description: Links to a gs1:PriceSpecification that indicates in terms of an amount and specified currency, the minimum discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'at least $10 off'.

minimumDiscountPercentage.description: A floating-point value indicating a minimum percentage discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'at least 15% discount'.

minimumQualifyingItems.description: Specifies the minimum number of items that must be purchased to qualify for a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'if you buy at least N items'.

minimumQualifyingSpend.description: Links to a gs1:PriceSpecification that indicates in terms of an amount and specified currency, the minimum spend required to qualify for a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'if you spend at least $100'.

offerRedemptionType.description: A code indicating the type of redemptions that apply to the offer, for example single use.

offerRestrictionDescription.description: A description of what the offer is restricted to, relative to all other offerings by the issuer, for example payment restrictions, subscription required, new customers only.

qualifyingBrandName.description: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product from one of the brand names specified via this property.

qualifyingGPCs.description: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product whose Global Product Classification (GPC) brick value appears in the list specified via this property.

qualifyingProductCategoryDescription.description: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product from categories specified in this free-form text field.

qualifyingProductClassificationCode.description: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product whose product classification (other than GPC) appears in the list specified via this property. This property specifies a product classification other than GPC.

qualifyingProductGTINs.description: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product whose GTIN appears in the list specified via this property.

qualifyingSubBrandName.description: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product from one of the sub-brand names (specified product ranges for a given brand) specified via this property.

selectedProductsOnly.description: If specified and set to true, the discount only applies to specific products selected by the retailer or offer promoter - not to all items in that product category. This property should be asserted and set to true for offers that say 'on selected products'.

DiscountTypeCode.description: GS1 code list DiscountTypeCode: members as compact IRIs gs1:<Code> (deprecated codes left out).

OfferRedemptionTypeCode.description: GS1 code list OfferRedemptionTypeCode: members as compact IRIs gs1:<Code> (deprecated codes left out).

PaymentMethod.description: GS1 code list PaymentMethod: members as compact IRIs gs1:<Code> (deprecated codes left out).

dutyFeeTaxAmount.description: The current tax or duty or fee amount applicable to the product, expressed as a floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding currency. See also gs1:priceCurrency.

dutyFeeTaxDescription.description: A description of tax type for example Taxes sure les supports audio.

dutyFeeTaxRate.description: The current tax or duty rate percentage applicable to the product.

maxPrice.description: Provides a maximum price value as a floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding currency. See also gs1:priceCurrency

minPrice.description: Provides a minimum price value as a floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding currency. See also gs1:priceCurrency

price.description: Provides a price value as a floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding currency. See also gs1:priceCurrency. The price value indicates the unit price unless the property gs1:eligibleQuantity is specified and indicates multiple units

priceCurrency.description: A string value indicating a currency from ISO 4217 for example USD .

validFrom.description: The effective start date of the price .

validThrough.description: The effective end date of the price .

unitCode.description: A string value indicating a Measurement Unit from UN/ECE Recommendation 20, Units of Measure used in International Trade e.g. GRM = gram - see http://www.unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/cefact/recommendations/rec20/rec20_rev3_Annex3e.pdf

value.description: A floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding measurement unit code - see gs1:unitCode

fileLanguageCode.description: The specified language to which the digital asset is targeted. It is recommended to use the ISO 639-1 language code.

filePixelHeight.description: The number of pixels along the vertical axis of the image.

filePixelWidth.description: The number of pixels along the horizontal axis of the image.

referencedFileEffectiveEndDateTime.description: The date upon which the target of this external link ceases to be effective for use.

referencedFileEffectiveStartDateTime.description: The date upon which the target of this external link begins to be effective for use.

referencedFileSize.description: The size of the file as it is stored in an uncompressed format.

referencedFileType.description: A code indicating the purpose or role of file (not a MIME type) that is being referenced, for example PRODUCT_LABEL_IMAGE. This code is used when the purpose of a file is not specified in the property.

referencedFileURL.description: Simple text string that refers to a resource on the internet, URLs may refer to documents, resources, people, etc.

ReferencedFileTypeCode.description: GS1 code list ReferencedFileTypeCode: members as compact IRIs gs1:<Code> (deprecated codes left out).

TradeChannelCode.description: GS1 code list TradeChannelCode: members as compact IRIs gs1:<Code> (deprecated codes left out).

durationOfWarranty.description: The time period that the warranty is valid within.

warrantyScopeDescription.description: The description of warranty available for the product. Allows for the representation of the same value in different languages but not for multiple values.
